propositions: The outbound mapper receives the assignee resolver via attribute injection (_assignee_resolver) rather than explicit parameter, making the dependency invisible to type checkers and caller contracts.

Silent failure occurs when the attribute injection does not complete; consumers discover the resolver via getattr with a permissive fallback, degrading assignee authority and causing unconvergent diff churn.

The Data Center adapter's dead-code bug in PR #120 was only detectable at review because the missing attribute had no contract signature, allowing an entire authoritative branch to go unexecuted without type or lint errors.

The resolver must be threaded through compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site, but DC's resolver is bound per-client at construction (no jira_key) while the core resolver is per-issue, requiring explicit parameter precedence logic.
All four injection and discovery sites must change: outbound_field_diff.py (core injection), jira/backend.py (Cloud getattr), jira_datacenter/backend.py (DC getattr and constructor injection).
